name: Data Root Selection Changes
description:
- When selecting a data root, filter missing roots so they appear at the bottom of the list
- Currently if you attempt to select a data root that is missing, it will give a notification that it does not exist and tell you to remove it from the list. What I want to have happen instead is a modal comes up and says "This data root no longer exists" and then prompt the user to delete the data root.

comments.body: Draft PR: https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/163 (branch factory/row-82-implementation, head b184dff8749123a1b98e790c6e6bd7e109955f28). Missing Data Roots are listed last in the startup picker and the D switcher. Picking one opens a modal that says the Data Root no longer exists and asks to delete it from the list (removes its ~/.rowblyrc.json entry); a root that vanishes after the list loads gets the same modal.
